research_scope: Source-free consolidation of 3 exact field-linear-operator occurrences and correction of same-meaning self-links and self-descriptive witness references.

amendments.review_rationale: Read eigenvalue of field-linear endomorphism by nontrivial kernel of A minus scalar identity, and preserved scalar field and operator domain-codomain match.
amendments.reason: Read the complete source formulation and compared its operator requirements with the independent field-vector-space linear-map meaning. A linear endomorphism is a K-linear map V to itself. Correct the prior unmatched operator occurrences and prevent variant/self-definition circularity in the eigenvalue-eigenvector relationship.

references.context: Kernel contains a nonzero vector, rather than merely the zero vector.

references.disposition: Lambda must belong to the scalar field of V, not an eigenvalue in an unstated field extension.

amendments.review_rationale: Read equivalent eigenvalue equation A(v)=λv for some nonzero vector and linked to same field-linear operator context, without requiring every vector to satisfy it.
amendments.reason: Read the complete source formulation and compared its operator requirements with the independent field-vector-space linear-map meaning. A linear endomorphism is a K-linear map V to itself. Correct the prior unmatched operator occurrences and prevent variant/self-definition circularity in the eigenvalue-eigenvector relationship.

references.disposition: The other formulation expresses the SAME eigenvalue meaning as this formulation. Its occurrence is a cross-variant explanation, not a mathematical prerequisite; retaining a link would create a spurious self-dependency.

Here the existence of a nonzero vector solving A(v)=lambda*v is part of the definition of eigenvalue itself, rather than a dependency on the separate eigenvector meaning (which itself invokes eigenvalue).

references.context: Image of selected nonzero vector is its scalar multiple by λ.

references.disposition: Exactly one witness vector suffices for eigenvalue status; the equation need not hold for all vectors.
